name: start button fully visible in a 1280×800 window without scrolling
expr: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.keycap.big').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top >= 0 && r.bottom <= window.innerHeight })()

name: the difficulty chips are not hidden behind the start row
expr: (() => { const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chip')], bar = document.querySelector('.start-row').getBoundingClientRect(); return chips.every(c => c.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= bar.top) })()
localStorage.setItem('wakppu.progress.rainbow.easy', JSON.stringify({ checkpoint: 1, elapsed: 30, steps: 10, savedAt: 1 })); true

name: resume button fully visible too
expr: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.keycap.big').getBoundingClientRect(); return document.querySelector('.keycap.big').textContent === '이어서 하기' && r.top >= 0 && r.bottom <= window.innerHeight })()
